findings.description: index.md states gbg doctor runs '47 read-only checks'. Counting every check!("ID", ...) registration in src/CLI/Doctor.jl (the only file that registers checks) gives 49 distinct ids — confirmed both by a raw check!( count (50, minus the one-line check! function definition = 49) and by sort -u of every check!("[A-Z_.]+" match (49 unique). Neither way gbg doctor actually runs matches 47 either: a default (non---deep) run executes 43 checks (49 minus the 6-entry DEEP set), and --deep executes all 49. So 47 is not the total, the quick-run count, or the deep-run count under any reading — a stale figure, violating RULE.DOC.CURRENT.
